messages:
maria: hey infra — quick question about `acme-corp` priv-VPC observability. customer says their requests are seeing high ingest latency into our collector. where should I look for prometheus/grafana links, otlp endpoints, and any log-forwarding backoff metrics?

aj: short answer — start with the customer-specific Grafana embed and the prom-remote_write target. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/priv/acme-corp (embed token required). check `prom_remote_write_queue_backend_seconds` and `remote_write_samples_dropped_total`.

maria: thanks. i only have access to the console link in the customer portal, not the embed. is there a quick way to get the dashboard tile or panel id to hand to support?

aj: ping @devops-bot for an embed token, but you can also open the portal -> Observability -> Dashboards -> "acme ingestion" and copy panel link. panel ids are usually like `panelId=21`.

kevin: for OTLP traces, look at the collector ingestion metrics: `otlp_receiver_requests_total` and `otlp_receiver_processing_seconds_bucket`. sampling can hide latency — ask if they enabled client-side sampling.

maria: do we have a standard promtail config we send to customers for privvpc? they mentioned backoff in logs.

olivia: yes — use the customer promtail snippet we publish. small copy: ```yaml
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
positions:
  filename: /tmp/positions.yaml
clients:
  - url: https://remote-write.redwood.internal/loki/acme-corp
    backoff_config:
      max_retries: 5
      min_period: 1s
      max_period: 30s
```

olivia: if promtail backoff is happening you'll see `loki_client_backoff_count_total` and `loki_client_batches_dropped_total` on the infra metrics cluster.

aj: another quick checklist: 1) confirm promtail TLS/cert is valid (expired certs cause 5xx + backoff). 2) confirm prom-remote_write queue size (`prometheus_remote_storage_queue_length`). 3) check routing rules in our gateway for high ingress spikes.

sre-oncall: i can run quick queries if you paste last 15m range. for example: `sum(rate(remote_write_samples_dropped_total[5m])) by (tenant)` and `sum(rate(otlp_receiver_processing_seconds_count[5m])) by (status)` — that surfaces errors vs slow processing.

maria: copying results here in a sec. also, which alert fires on prom remote write queue growth? we get a lot of noisy alerts.

olivia: the alert is `PromRemoteWriteQueueHigh` (priority: P2). threshold 80% of configured queue_capacity. happy to propose a temporary suppression for acme while they debug.

maria: ok attaching short output: `remote_write_samples_dropped_total{tenant="acme-corp"} = 42` over last 10m, and `otlp_receiver_processing_seconds_bucket` shows increased p99 ~ 1.8s.

kevin: 42 dropped is concerning but not catastrophic. p99 ~1.8s suggests worker saturation — check replica counts for the collector deployment in their region and any recent config changes (batch size, max_concurrency).

aj: i've looked at the gateway logs: lots of 429s to the collector cluster from that tenant's IPCIDR. likely batch size/throughput mismatch. i'll open a short-lived autoscale bump for the collector pool and let it stabilize.

maria: thank you. can you also drop links to the specific dashboards/panels I should clip into the customer ticket? less back-and-forth.

aj: sure — panels to share: ingestion queue panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/priv/acme-corp?view=ingest-panel&panelId=21, remote_write drops: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/priv/acme-corp?view=drops&panelId=7, otlp processing: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/priv/acme-corp?view=traces&panelId=13

olivia: filing a small runbook snippet you can paste into the support ticket: "Checks for high priv-VPC ingest latency: 1) promtail certs & endpoint reachability 2) prom-remote_write queue metrics (queue_length, dropped samples) 3) collector replica CPU/memory and concurrency settings 4) gateway 429s and IPCIDR throttling config 5) transient backoff metrics in loki/promtail"

maria: perfect. last ask — tagging folks for code review on a small promtail change (reduce batch_size) — @aj @kevin can you take a quick look when you have 10m? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/priv-templates/pull/452

aj: will do after this spike is stabilized.

kevin: can do in ~20m.

sre-oncall: I'll keep an eye on the alert and mute noisy duplicates once we confirm the autoscale bump. ping me if you want a manual rollback. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket with the dashboard links and the runbook snippet. closing here after we confirm drops go to zero. :rocket:
